exclusion_reason: The packed single/double float arithmetic and 128-bit logical SSE forms execute over the xmm file and match an independent strict per-lane IEEE-754 reference to zero ULP, but the x87 path is 64-bit precision (80-bit extended precision is not modeled) and AVX-256 width is not covered, so the full packed-and-80-bit vectorization within the declared tolerance is not met.
promotion_trigger: Promote to passing when the packed, 80-bit x87, and AVX fixtures all match within the frozen tolerance and the strict fallback matches the primary path across every declared width.
expected_failing_assertion: The 80-bit x87 extended-precision path and the 256-bit AVX register width are not modeled, so the packed-and-80-bit tolerance fixture cannot pass across every declared width.
active_gate_evidence: test/simd.test.mjs runs the interpreter's packed SSE battery (addps/mulps/subps/addpd/mulpd and andps/orps/xorps) as the primary path and asserts every operation matches an independent strict per-lane IEEE-754 reference (the strict fallback) to zero ULP, and pins that the 80-bit x87 and AVX-256 legs stay red (covers_80bit_x87 and covers_avx256 false, is_bar_cleared false).
procedure: Run the packed SIMD and 80-bit x87 fixture on the primary path.
Compare against the reference within the frozen tolerance metadata.
Run the strict-SIMD fallback on the same fixture and compare.
pass_criterion: Packed and 80-bit behavior matches within the declared tolerance.
The strict fallback matches the primary path.
